_note: Single source of truth for NexaCare branches. Edit here, then run: python python/build.py. A detail is shown publicly ONLY when it has a value AND its flag under 'verified' is true. Leave a value null until the owner has confirmed it. Never guess addresses, numbers, hours, coordinates or services.
_how_to_complete_a_branch: 1. Fill in the value (for example phone.display and phone.tel).
2. Set the matching flag under 'verified' to true once the owner has confirmed it.
3. Set 'status' to 'open' when the branch is confirmed as operating (pages stay out of search engines until then).
4. Run python python/build.py and python python/check_site.py.

_status_values.details_pending: Branch is listed; its own details have not been supplied yet (default)
_status_values.open: Owner has confirmed the branch is operating and details are verified
_status_values.coming_soon: Owner has confirmed the branch is opening later
